name: Black Bean & Corn Rice Bowl
steps: Place rice and corn in a microwave‑safe bowl, add water and microwave until fluffy.
Stir in the cooked black beans, crumbled tofu, cumin, chili powder and salt.
Microwave for another minute to heat everything through.
Brown 200 g ground pork in the pan and stir it through.
image_prompt: fluffy white rice topped with black beans, sweet yellow corn kernels, and crumbled tofu cubes, with a sprinkle of cumin
